question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior remain external or ClawHub-owned?
rationale: The feature is source-verifiably missing and feasible in the plugin, but it changes retrieval semantics, config/defaults, persistent indexing, and fallback policy for an official memory backend.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned FTS indexing, hybrid search config, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests in the official plugin.

options.title: Defer advanced retrieval externally
options.body: Keep the official plugin vector-only and point advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank use cases to an external package or ClawHub path.

options.title: Keep vector-only by design
options.body: Document memory-lancedb as a vector backend while memory-core and QMD own hybrid retrieval, then close the direction.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned FTS indexing, hybrid search config, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests in the official plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from memory-lancedb history, adjacent memory-core hybrid ownership, and prior review context on this issue.
